dialogues.welcomeHousekeeper: Ah, fresh meat. You must be the new housekeeper.
dialogues.closeDoors: Always close the door behind you, or they might let themselves in while you clean.
dialogues.bathroomWarning: If you hear something in the bathroom, don't open it. And don't trust the silence: they can be quiet too.
dialogues.hideImmediately: Knocking? The TV or radio switching on by itself? Hide. Now.
dialogues.checkRoom: Check every inch of the room. They love a good hiding spot.
dialogues.spotWarning: If you spot one of them, close the door and get out. Fast.
dialogues.wellDone: Not bad. Now clean 8 rooms and you can call it a night.
dialogues.turnBack: Remember: if you see one of them in a room, turn back immediately.
dialogues.infested: Half of these rooms are infested, and never the same ones twice. Tread carefully.
dialogues.bathroomTasks: Bathroom jobs vary: stains, trash, spiders... Some are hard to spot.
